messages:
Maya Chen: Need to lock EmberPoint case study flow: blog, hero quote, webinar 4/22, and a short demo clip. Legal needs signed release + metric provenance before publish. Owners?
Gabi Rivera: I can own customer liaison and quote approvals. Will request a signed release today.
Leo Park: Customer sent headshot and logo. Drafted three hero quote options: 
1) "Redwood reduced our inference spend and made latency predictable."
2) "35% lower per-request cost after Dedicated + batching/KV cache."
3) "Integration was seamless; SLAs improved immediately."
Jack O'Neill: Option 2 needs written confirmation of the 35% and a short methodology blurb for the appendix. Also, paid ads need explicit permission.
Ana Morales: CS will export the benchmark CSV (catalog-search workload, median seq len 60). I'll sanitize and share.
Shane Patel: Clarifying: 35% is token-unit cost reduction with batching=auto + KV cache; raw op reduction ~27%. We'll include both in the appendix and use conservative phrasing.
DesignBot: Mockups uploaded (16:9 social card, benchmark slide, thumbnail). Figma link posted.
Maya Chen: Action list: Gabi4 approvals + release; Ana4 benchmark CSV; Leo4 final quote + blog copy; Design4 assets; Jack4 legal wording. Internal review 4/15, final signoff 4/20.
Gabi Rivera: Pinged EmberPoint GC for release and paid-ad permission. Will update here when signed. :thumbsup:
Leo Park: Draft blog opener and tweet thread ready; will post when quote and numbers are confirmed.
Jack O'Neill: I'll review legal language as soon as the release arrives and post any redlines here.
Maya Chen: Thanks — if we get approvals, publish blog + webinar + organic social same day; hold paid until specific ad permission received.
